messages:
jess_cust: Hey team — since last deploy we're seeing streaming responses cut off with a connection reset. Happens in eu-west-1. correlation-id: cid-7f9e2, request: req-0acb. Client sees partial JSON like "{\"output\": \"Hello"" then connection drops.

jess_cust: curl shows `Connection reset by peer` after about 12s. Repro is intermittent (~1/20 requests). Full curl:
```
curl -i -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \\n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-13b"
```

oliver_support: thanks — can you confirm SDKs and exact timestamps? also any proxy between client and our edge?

jess_cust: Node 0.12.3, Python 0.8.1. No customer proxy, but traffic goes through our corporate edge (FastEdge) before reaching you. timestamps: first occurrence 2025-06-12T15:20:33Z.

maria_eng: FYI saw a similar symptom during the gzip changes branch — edge was closing connection when compressed chunk header split a JSON object across frames.

tim_runtime: can you share the raw SSE chunks from the client? even a trimmed example helps. Also please upload the correlation-id server-side logs. We saw `RST_STREAM` to edge at ~12s in other reports.

jess_cust: attaching trimmed client capture:
```
event: message
data: {"id": "1", "delta": "Hel"

event: message
data: {"delta": "lo", "choice": 1}
```
Then immediately client logs `Error: socket hang up` and curl prints `Connection reset by peer`.

oliver_support: can you try forcing `Accept-Encoding: identity` to disable gzip as a quick test?

jess_cust: tried that — still saw one reset but less frequent. Also saw `out of memory` in our edge logs around same time.

maria_eng: ok, action plan: 1) eng-runtime to pull edge proxy traces for cid-7f9e2, 2) check kernel OOM / worker restart on edge, 3) reproduce with a local FastEdge instance using large streamed responses to try to trigger split-chunk close.

tim_runtime: temporary mitigation: enable smaller max_chunk_size on runtime (queue config) and disable Brotli/gzip until we fix edge handshake. I'll open a canary rollout with that change.

alerts-bot: incident created: INC-20250612-1473 assigned to eng-runtime. Tags: streaming, edge-reset, split-json.

oliver_support: thx — we'll follow up with timeline + pcap request once eng-runtime has logs.
